subject: general
question: Rahul and Neha met on 24th January 2011 at City Hall. After that, accidentally they met again on 23rd January 2019 at the same place. After how many days did they meet the second time?
solution:
Given that:-

Rahul and Neha met on 24th January 2011 at City Hall. After that, accidentally they met again on 23rd January 2019 at the same place.

Now calculating after how many days did they meet the second time:-

 
• From 24th January 2011 to 24th January 2012 (Non-leap year) = 365 days
 
• From 24th January 2012 to 24th January 2013 (Leap year) = 366 days
 
• From 24th January 2013 to 24th January 2
